title: Small transcriptional differences among cell clones lead to distinct NF-kappaB dynamics.
authors: Kizilirmak, Cise; Monteleone, Emanuele; Garcia-Manteiga, Jose Manuel; Brambilla, Francesca; Agresti, Alessandra; Bianchi, Marco E; Zambrano, Samuel
one_liner_zh: 该文研究细胞克隆间转录差异导致NF-kappaB动态异质性，结合转录组与模拟，但核心是信号通路动态而非TF-DNA结合互作建模，方法为模拟而非AI/物理模拟，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Transcription factor dynamics is fundamental to determine the activation of accurate transcriptional programs and yet is heterogeneous at a single-cell level, even within homogeneous populations. We asked how such heterogeneity emerges for the nuclear factor kappaB (NF-kappaB). We found that clonal populations of immortalized fibroblasts derived from a single mouse embryo display robustly distinct NF-kappaB dynamics upon tumor necrosis factor a (TNF-a) stimulation including persistent, oscillatory, and weak activation, giving rise to differences in the transcription of its targets. By combining transcriptomics and simulations we show how less than two-fold differences in the expression levels of genes coding for key proteins of the signaling cascade and feedback system are predictive of the differences of the NF-kappaB dynamic response of the clones to TNF-a and IL-1beta. We propose that small transcriptional differences in the regulatory circuit of a transcription factor can lead to distinct signaling dynamics in cells within homogeneous cell populations and among different cell types.
abstract_zh: 转录因子动力学对于决定精确转录程序的激活至关重要，然而即使在同质群体中，其在单细胞水平上也是异质的。我们探究了这种异质性如何出现在核因子kappaB（NF-kappaB）中。我们发现，源自单个小鼠胚胎的永生化成纤维细胞克隆群体在肿瘤坏死因子a（TNF-a）刺激下表现出显著不同的NF-kappaB动力学，包括持续性、振荡性和弱激活，从而导致其靶基因转录的差异。通过结合转录组学和模拟，我们展示了信号级联和反馈系统中关键蛋白编码基因表达水平上不到两倍的差异，如何预测克隆对TNF-a和IL-1beta的NF-kappaB动态响应的差异。我们提出，转录因子调控回路中的微小转录差异可导致同质细胞群体内及不同细胞类型间细胞信号动力学的显著不同。
